text: Water is stirred into milk powder until it is liquid milk again. With whole milk powder the fat is already in it.

steps.note: The water is added to skim milk powder, whole milk powder or both; with whole powder the fat is already in it.
The milk is heated as pasteurised or UHT (ultra-high-temperature) milk is.
